services.name: Charter cost
services.desc: The GULF STREAM comes closer to land off the shores of Palm Beach more than anywhere else in the United States. At times, the Gulf Stream can be less than a mile from the beach. Its crystal clear waters make it unmistakable. During the. winter months, thousands of sailfish migrate down the edge of the Gulf Stream bringing them only a mile off the edge of the Palm Beach coast. It’s not uncommon to have multiple hook ups at one time. This is strictly catch and release. And what an adrenalin rush! We also catch many wahoo, kingfish, blackfin tuna, amberjack. These fish are abundant in Palm Beach waters! We have the experience to put you on the fish. Its a lot of fun to shark fish and we can

blurb: Guests choose either 4, 6, or 8 hour private fishing charters. Fishing styles include trolling or live bait fishing. The charters target species like tarpon and snook in the Palm Beach and Jupiter Inlets area.

quotes.author: Lori Gatton
quotes.text: Captain Tony and Mate Rusty are Outstanding! My family of 6 enjoyed a 4 hour charter . I really enjoyed watching and making pictures of my 3 Grand Sons reeling in their catch ! We caught lots of fish and even the battle my Son had reelin in a 200 pound Reef Shark ! Rusty kept 6 lines baited with secrete proven baits . They have over 40 years experience fishing in this area !

quotes.author: jeff brodek
quotes.text: I have been fishing with Captain Tony on the Showtime for 20 years. He Is very passionate about catching fish and knows where to find them. The boat and tackle are always well-maintained and the captain and mate work hard the whole trip. I highly recommend Captain Tony and the Showtime.

quotes.author: J Emerson
quotes.text: Captain Tony was very professional and went the extra mile to make my fishing experience memorable. He was very informative about the shipwrecks and reef approaching upon. Very happy with this trip
